protocol: fold-causal multi-step validation with nested early stopping
selection_rule: lowest pooled multi-step validation WAPE over folds 2-4; every arm predicts each fold window 7 days ahead from the fold origin; recovery and FeatureBuilder refit per fold on data up to the fold train_end (fold-causal); boosting iterations chosen on an inner temporal split of the fold-training window (nested; outer fold untouched by training); recentering calibrators fit only on earlier folds (default config, sp_shrink=28, horizon_shrink=5000); fold 1 excluded from pooling (calibrator seed); eligible arms: A0, A1, A2, A3, A5; diagnostic-only: A4a, A4b (latent-demand heads)
promotion_gate: incumbent = A3 (recursive + CV recentering); candidate promotes iff G1 pooled val WAPE < incumbent, G2 wins >= 2 of 3 pooled folds, G3 |pooled val WPE| <= incumbent + 1.0 pp, G4 runtime <= 3x incumbent; test never participates
